description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The token must contain only ASCII characters and be no more than 64 characters in length.

Zone ID，Zone的唯一识别码。

description.en:
The unique ID of the zone.

> You must dissociate a built-in authoritative domain name from its scope before you delete it.

descriptions.zh:
#### 注意事项
已配置域名生效范围的内置权威域名，必须先将其与域名生效范围解除关联，然后才能删除。
descriptions.en:
#### Notes

You must dissociate a zone from its scope before you delete it.
